classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the uniformly sloping pool as a trapezium prism, calculate its volume, convert to litres and divide by supplied flow.

content.prompt: A school swimming pool has dimensions as shown. How long would it take to fill this pool if the pump can deliver 1500 litres of water a minute?

spec.description: Actual source open pool25m long12m wide, shallow1m/deep2m, uniformly sloping floor, horizontal rectangle opening, source hidden red dashed edges and physical projected right-angle marks. No inferred values printed.
spec.mathematics: Physical vertices y0 rim, shallow−1/deep−2; all five openpool wall/floor faces and actual view preserved. Source-native mathematical depth2, not sibling2.3.

answer.worked: The average depth of the uniformly sloping pool is $\frac{(1+2)}{2}=1.5$ m. Thus $V=25\times12\times1.5=450\text{ m}^3=450\,000\text{ L}$. Time $=450\,\frac{000}{1500}=300$ minutes.
